description: Controlled vocabulary, business definitions, and ontology for the 12 mortgage-lending decisions defined in decisions.yaml.

credit_score.definition: Numeric credit-risk score returned by a credit bureau. FICO range 300-850; lower is higher risk.

credit_band.definition: Discrete bucketing of credit_score (e.g. super_prime, prime, near_prime, subprime) used for downstream pricing and eligibility.

dti.definition: Total monthly debt obligations divided by verified gross monthly income. Lower is better; QM ceiling generally 0.43.

ltv.definition: Loan amount divided by appraised property value. PMI typically required above 0.80; agency guidelines cap most products at 0.97.

stated_income.definition: Income declared by the applicant before independent verification. Must never feed dti_calculation directly.

verified_income.definition: Income confirmed against payroll, tax returns, or bank statements. Required input to dti_calculation.

employment_type.definition: Classification of how the applicant earns income.

income_confidence_score.definition: Confidence (0-1) that verified_income reflects sustainable, repeatable earnings.

intent_score.definition: Probability (0-1) that an inbound lead converts into a funded application.

fraud_score.definition: Probability (0-1) that an application contains fraudulent identity, document, or behavioral signals.

identity_match_confidence.definition: Confidence (0-1) that submitted identity documents match the applicant of record.

document_authenticity_score.definition: Confidence (0-1) that an uploaded document has not been forged or altered.

watchlist_match.definition: True if the applicant matches an entry on a sanctions, AML, or fraud watchlist.

synthetic_identity_flag.definition: True if the identity bundle (SSN, name, DOB, address) shows signatures of a synthetic identity.

appraised_value.definition: Independent appraiser estimate of the property's market value.

purchase_price.definition: Agreed-upon contract price between buyer and seller.

loan_purpose.definition: Why the loan is being originated.

rate_pricing.definition: Annual interest rate offered to the applicant after pricing adjustments.

llpa.definition: Loan-Level Price Adjustment — basis-point add-on to the rate based on risk attributes (credit, LTV, occupancy).

risk_score.definition: Composite risk (0-1) computed by the senior underwriting agent across all upstream signals.

fair_lending_violation.definition: True if the application or proposed terms appear to violate fair-lending statutes (ECOA, FHA).

hmda_fields.definition: Required Home Mortgage Disclosure Act reporting fields for the loan.

cd_timing_compliant.definition: True if the Closing Disclosure was delivered at least 3 business days before consummation (TRID rule).

title_clear.definition: True if the title search returned no liens, defects, or encumbrances blocking conveyance.

fraud_watchlist.definition: Reference dataset of known-bad identities, devices, and IPs.

regulatory_constraints.definition: State and federal rules that gate the application — usury caps, disclosure timing, fair-lending checks.

product_catalog.definition: Registry of currently-offered loan products with their guidelines.

lead_scoring.purpose: Evaluate inbound leads for intent quality and conversion likelihood before opening an application.

income_verification.purpose: Validate stated income against payroll, tax, and bank statements; produce verified_income with a confidence.

credit_assessment.purpose: Pull and interpret bureau data to determine credit_band and derogatory profile.

fraud_screening.purpose: Detect identity fraud, synthetic identity, document forgery, and watchlist hits.

compliance_check.purpose: Validate the application against HMDA, ECOA, fair-lending, and state-specific rules.

dti_calculation.purpose: Compute debt-to-income ratio using verified_income (never stated_income) and existing obligations.

ltv_assessment.purpose: Compute loan-to-value ratio against the appraised property value, gated by credit_band.

product_eligibility.purpose: Determine which loan products the applicant qualifies for given DTI, LTV, credit_band, and income type.

rate_pricing.purpose: Determine interest rate and LLPAs based on credit_score, DTI, LTV, and loan_type.

underwriting_decision.purpose: Synthesise all upstream signals into approve, conditional_approve, or decline.

approval_routing.purpose: Route the underwriting outcome to the right downstream workflow (approval letter, counter-offer, decline notice).

closing_readiness.purpose: Confirm all conditions, title, insurance, and CD-timing are satisfied before scheduling closing.

ontology.description: Business object model. The 8 object_types are persistent system-of-record entities. The system_object_types are runtime artifacts produced by the decision pipeline (Decision, DecisionTrace, AgentLearning).

Applicant.semantic_definition: A natural person who has interacted with the lender — the WHO. Persists across applications and across time. One Applicant may submit many Applications, may co-apply with another Applicant, and accumulates multiple credit / income / fraud profiles over their lifetime. Re-applications reuse the Applicant; they do not create a new one.

links.name: submits
links.semantic_meaning: An applicant submits many applications over their lifetime. Each application is a fresh request, never a mutation of a prior one.

links.name: has_credit_profile
links.semantic_meaning: One CreditProfile per bureau pull. Old profiles are retained; never overwritten.

links.name: has_income_profile
links.semantic_meaning: One IncomeProfile per verification event.

links.name: has_fraud_profile
links.semantic_meaning: One FraudProfile per screening run. Identity does not reset across applications.

links.name: co_applies_with
links.semantic_meaning: Joint applicants on a single Application. Symmetric — if A co-applies with B, B co-applies with A.

Application.semantic_definition: A specific loan request made by an Applicant against a specific Property at a specific moment — the WHAT THEY ARE ASKING FOR NOW. Has its own lifecycle (intake → underwriting → approved | declined → closed). A re-application creates a NEW Application; the prior one is closed, not edited.

links.name: submitted_by
links.semantic_meaning: The primary applicant of record. Co-applicants are reached via Applicant.co_applies_with.

links.name: secured_by
links.semantic_meaning: The subject property collateralizing this loan.

links.name: requests
links.semantic_meaning: The loan terms being requested or offered for this application.

links.name: evaluated_by
links.semantic_meaning: The 12 lending decisions evaluated for this application; see decisions.yaml for the dependency graph.

links.name: governed_by
links.semantic_meaning: Compliance posture for this application — HMDA, fair-lending, TRID timing. Owned by the Application; never shared.

Property.semantic_definition: The real-property asset securing the loan. Belongs to a single Application — different applications have different Property objects, even at the same address.

links.name: secures
links.semantic_meaning: Inverse of Application.secured_by.

Loan.semantic_definition: The loan product and terms being requested or offered. Tightly coupled to one Application — re-pricing or product changes within the same application mutate this Loan, but a new Application creates a new Loan.

links.name: requested_in
links.semantic_meaning: Inverse of Application.requests.

CreditProfile.semantic_definition: Snapshot of an Applicant's credit at a point in time, from a specific bureau. Immutable — a re-pull creates a new CreditProfile rather than overwriting. Belongs to the Applicant, not to any one Application, so re-applications can reuse a recent pull within retention.

links.name: belongs_to
links.semantic_meaning: The applicant this snapshot belongs to.

IncomeProfile.semantic_definition: Verified income snapshot for an Applicant, optionally scoped to a specific Application. Belongs to the Applicant so re-applications can carry forward a recent verification within retention; the application_id is recorded for trace, not ownership.

links.name: belongs_to
links.semantic_meaning: The applicant whose income this snapshot represents.

links.name: scoped_to
links.semantic_meaning: Income verification is usually triggered by an Application, but the result attaches to the Applicant.

FraudProfile.semantic_definition: Identity / fraud signals collected for an Applicant. Belongs to the Applicant because identity does not reset across applications — a fraud signal seen on application N+1 must be informed by what was seen on application N.

links.name: belongs_to
links.semantic_meaning: The applicant this fraud snapshot belongs to.

ComplianceRecord.semantic_definition: Compliance posture for a single Application — HMDA, ECOA / fair-lending, state-specific rules, TRID timing. Owned by the Application; never shared across applications, because the regulatory snapshot is application-specific.

links.name: governs
links.semantic_meaning: Inverse of Application.governed_by.

Decision.semantic_definition: A business decision artifact emitted by an agent against an Application. Each of the 12 decisions in decisions.yaml produces one Decision per Application per evaluation pass.

links.name: depends_on
links.semantic_meaning: Dependency edges from decisions.yaml depends_on. Forms a DAG. A dependent decision cannot run until its upstream Decisions are emitted.

links.name: produces
links.semantic_meaning: Every Decision produces exactly one DecisionTrace — hard rule no_execution_without_trace.

DecisionTrace.semantic_definition: Full audit record of a Decision execution: inputs snapshot, structured WorkJournalEntry reasoning, policy outcome, critic review, and (if applicable) human review. See core/trace/trace_schema.py.

links.name: triggers
links.semantic_meaning: On human_override only. The override reason becomes an AgentLearning record fed back to the same agent on next similar event. See reflection block in decisions.yaml.

AgentLearning.semantic_definition: A human override captured as a learning signal for the originating agent. Retained for reflection.retention_days; consulted by the boundary engine on subsequent similar events.
